title: The Last Page of January
skyStory: The waning crescent moon has escaped Scorpio and bolted into Sagittarius, twenty-nine percent bright and already packing for February. Sagittarius is the archer, and tonight it has an arrow aimed straight at next month with a note tied to it. The note says: well done, January. The storm is clearing. The stars are polishing themselves for the occasion.

reading: Last day of the first month, Tiger, and you made it through thirty-one days of fires, moons and narwhals. Somewhere in a hiding place there is a tiny paper tiger with your resolution folded inside. Do not open it yet. It is waiting for March. Just know it is still there, and that you are still on course.

Today Sagittarius wants one small adventure to close the month: a snowy walk to a place you have never been, even if it is only the end of a road you always drive past. Around 3 pm the sun will break through, briefly and dramatically. The [[Knight of Wands]] salutes you. One fire, aimed well, all month.
joel.mission: Walk somewhere you have never walked before today, even a short distance, and name the spot January's End.
joel.omen: Sun breaking through clouds after the storm. It means February will open with good news.
joel.stoneWhy: Nancy's fire to close the month

reading: January ends on the shore, the storm cleared, the snow fresh and the water sparkling the way it only does after a big wind. You started this month ten days after your birthday, with a head start, and you used it beautifully. Quiet progress, every single day. Mountains approve.

Tonight, look back at the list of Things Nobody Else Noticed that you started on January 2. Read every entry. That list is proof that your Wood Rat eyes find magic in the ordinary. The [[Six of Swords]] has nearly reached the far shore. Wave at it. February is right there, waving back.
nancy.mission: Reread your Things Nobody Else Noticed list from January 2, and add one final January entry.
nancy.omen: Fresh snow glittering at the water's edge at sunset. It means the next month holds a beautiful surprise.

together.text: Close out January together. Each of you gives the month a grade, a title and one favourite moment, in a single message. Then pick February's first shared mission. The archer is ready to fire. Equinox and solstice, one month down, eleven to go.
